personal.description: Personal API authentication uses Flume's official Personal API credentials from {api_url}. It supports Personal API reads, including notifications, but portal-only write operations require Portal authentication.
personal.title: Sign in with the Personal API

portal.description: Portal authentication uses the same customer-portal OAuth flow as Flume's web app. It supports normal Flume reads plus portal features and writes such as usage-alert rules, schedules, spans, integrations, budgets, subscriptions, and meter-accuracy tools. Notifications work with this method too.
portal.title: Sign in with the Flume portal

reauth_confirm.description: The credentials for {username} are no longer valid.
reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate your Flume account

user.description: Choose how Home Assistant should connect to Flume. Portal authentication is recommended because it supports the full PyFlumeNG feature set. Personal API authentication remains available for existing API clients.
user.title: Connect to your Flume account

call_api.description: Expert escape hatch for allowlisted read-only PyFlumeNG get/list methods. Writes, raw requests, credential-bearing reads, commerce, and support side effects are blocked; sensitive response fields are redacted. Prefer the first-class Flume actions above.

arguments.description: Keyword arguments for the selected read-only method, as an object.
arguments.name: Arguments

config_entry.description: The Flume config entry to use.
config_entry.name: Flume account

method.description: An allowlisted PyFlumeNG get/list method. Use List expert read-only API methods to discover available methods.
method.name: Read-only method

call_api.name: Expert: call read-only PyFlumeNG API

check_meter_accuracy.description: Runs the safe read-only meter-accuracy precheck for the selected water sensor. It does not upload readings or photos and does not start a support conversation.

device.description: The Flume water sensor to use.
device.name: Water sensor

check_meter_accuracy.name: Check meter accuracy

create_budget.description: Creates a DAILY, WEEKLY, or MONTHLY Flume water budget. Percentage thresholds entered here are converted to Flume's absolute-gallon thresholds.

device.description: The Flume water sensor to use.
device.name: Water sensor

payload.description: Optional raw compatibility payload. Prefer the typed fields in this action.
payload.name: Legacy payload

threshold_percentages.description: One or more percentages of the target at which to alert. Home Assistant converts these to the absolute-gallon thresholds used by Flume.
threshold_percentages.name: Alert thresholds (%)

type.description: Budget recurrence: DAILY, WEEKLY, or MONTHLY.
type.name: Budget period

create_budget.name: Create water budget

create_do_not_alert_schedule.description: Creates a weekly period during which matching Flume alerts are suppressed. Portal authentication is required. End time must be at least four minutes after start time.

description.description: Optional description for the do-not-alert schedule.
description.name: Description

device.description: The Flume water sensor to use.
device.name: Water sensor

end_time.description: Local end time. It must be at least four minutes after the start time.
end_time.name: End time

name.description: A readable name from 1 to 32 characters.
name.name: Name

payload.description: Optional raw compatibility payload. Prefer the typed fields in this action.
payload.name: Legacy payload

span_types.description: Optional usage classifications to which the schedule applies. Leave empty to omit this field.
span_types.name: Span types

start_time.description: Local start time for suppressing alerts.
start_time.name: Start time

weekdays.description: Days of the week on which this schedule repeats.
weekdays.name: Weekdays

create_do_not_alert_schedule.name: Create do-not-alert schedule

create_emergency_contact.description: Creates an emergency contact for the selected Flume location using the same name-and-email flow as the Flume portal. The contact may receive emergency water alerts.

email_address.name: Email address

create_emergency_contact.name: Create emergency contact

create_usage_alert_rule.description: Creates a normal Flume usage-alert rule using typed fields. Portal authentication is required. Smart Leak (advanced low-flow) rules are managed separately by Flume; the legacy payload field is only for compatibility.

active.description: Whether the usage-alert rule is enabled.
active.name: Active

device.description: The Flume water sensor to use.
device.name: Water sensor

duration.description: How many minutes the flow must continue before the rule triggers, from 5 through 1439 minutes.
duration.name: Duration

flow_rate.description: Flow-rate threshold in gallons per minute, from 0 through 40.9.
flow_rate.name: Flow rate

name.description: A readable name from 1 to 32 characters.
name.name: Name

notify_every.description: Minutes between repeat notifications. Flume requires this to be at least twice the rule duration. If omitted when creating a rule, Home Assistant uses twice the duration automatically.
notify_every.name: Notify every

payload.description: Optional raw compatibility payload. Prefer the typed fields in this action.
payload.name: Legacy payload

create_usage_alert_rule.name: Create usage-alert rule
